content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 28-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment is 28th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Project Research Scientist-II (Medical), Research Associate-I, and Research Associate-II in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria vary for each post. Generally, it includes MBBS/BDS with relevant experience, MPH/MPI degrees, or a Ph.D., as specified in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided to reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves email application screening, followed by shortlisting of eligible candidates, and finally, an interview to assess their suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) post will receive a salary of 80,000 plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Research Associate-I and II posts?
faq.answer: For Research Associate-II, the salary is 61,000 + 30% HRA, and for Research Associate-I, it is 58,000 + 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q9. How should candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply via email. They must prepare their application with all necessary details and documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.
